notes.title: Hello Next Fest!
notes.notes:
I am so grateful that so many of you have decided to give Daedalus a shot! I was amazed to see that yesterday, over 2000 people from around the world (big shout out to Argentina with 24% of all downloads!) downloaded the demo! I really hope that you all enjoy my silly little game and that it brings you some joy!

I am just putting the finishing touches on the final bosses of the inner chambers and dialogue prompts, so I will keep this short. I am so excited to release the full game, I have put a great deal of work into making the classes interesting and distinct, so I hope they will be a valuable reward for your progression.

Please feel free to use the feedback system in the help menu, I would love to hear what you all think, as there is still time to make adjustments before the launch!

Have a great week, I’ll see you on launch day Monday!
daphii ♥
